_comment: Hand-verified per-pair detail captured by an earlier session (arena/8b1f0fd8-poker2 and before), preserved verbatim because scripts/build-walk.py cannot regenerate it: the routed-via service name, the date each route was routed, the routed distance, and the official interior-route wording with its source. build-walk.py merges this over the OSRM matrix in data/site/walking.json, preferring the longer official route text.

pairs.routed_via: Same building/resort: no outdoor route applies; official indoor route text is on the row
pairs.route_official: Indoor, same building: "Proceed across The Palazzo Casino Floor to the self-parking elevators. Take the elevator up to level 2, Grand Canal Shoppes. Enter Grand Canal Shoppes and take a left at Liam's Den and Bubble Bar. The Poker Room will be straight ahead."

pairs.routed_via: Same building/resort: no outdoor route applies; official indoor route text is on the row
pairs.route_official: Indoor, same resort: "Proceed across The Venetian casino floor, to Restaurant Row. Enter the Waterfall Atrium. Look for the escalator by the Waterfall Atrium. Take the escalator up to level 2, Grand Canal Shoppes. Make a u-turn and take the hallway to the right. Turn right at EJ Pretty and The Poker Room will be on your right."
